notes: A failed update stays visible and retries cleanly, and a relaunch during ShipIt's wait is told so. updateStore.ts no longer folds an install failure back to idle on the next automatic check (only a failed probe is hidden; canRetry keeps the failure until the user retries), and a manual check on a failed install asks "Download it again?" before re-downloading (updater.ts). clearStaleUpdate in update.ts removes Squirrel's launchd job (<bundleId>.ShipIt) before deleting its state: a ShipIt from the last hand-over can still be alive waiting for this app to quit, and launchd respawned it every two seconds once the state file was gone. describeInstallFailure (updateInstall.ts) reports "The update is waiting for the app to quit" when ShipIt has logged only the install request and no outcome, which is what an app relaunched during the first attempt's wait sees. scripts/e2e-updater.ts gains the busy and still-running scenarios the fix thread drove: restart with a Haiku turn running goes through the quit question and swaps in seconds; a second instance blocks ShipIt, the relaunched app shows the failure and a retry re-downloads. Tests: updateInstall, updateStore, updater.
